purpose: Exact-owner multi-world conformance proving that ordinary source is a sufficient recoverable carrier of explicit authored Wiki topology, while backlinks/indexes remain rebuildable consequences consumed through the existing Living Wiki, Flow, desktop and Projection field. This W8 cut is re-rooted directly on the exact O:I main that accepted #150; the conformance commit under test is supplied by the PR/run receipt.

central.role: stable source/Flow identity, source revision and Source Change Horizon authority

ai-kit.role: accepted authored-relation contract: Markdown/OKF source interpretation, authored-relation evidence/resolution, unresolved state, SemanticWiki rebuild/backlinks and Living Knowledge dependencies

software-factory.role: software Project/Run cognition and opaque relation-evidence return path

worlds.name: ordinary-markdown-wiki
proves: ordinary Markdown pages remain canonical source while authored relation/backlink/search state is derived
Obsidian-style wikilinks, normal Markdown links and optional OKF Properties enter one source-authored relation field without destructive normalisation
resolved relation evidence retains source identity, revision, authored spelling/anchor/channel and epistemic standing
unresolved or ambiguous targets remain inspectable authored evidence instead of synthetic graph truth
deleting derived SemanticWiki relation/backlink/search state and rebuilding from the same eligible sources recovers the authored relation field
source interpretation and rebuild perform zero automatic Agent/model invocation

worlds.name: flow
proves: blank-created Flow may develop ordinary prose links without visible frontmatter
a stable FlowRef may be an authored relation subject while its SourceRef remains exact source provenance
Flow participates without becoming a WikiNode, second Wiki store or AgentSession replacement
linked-source revision change enters Living Knowledge impact/freshness with zero implicit Contemplate
AgentSession remains canonical acting/conversation continuity beside Flow continuity

worlds.name: deep-structured-knowledge
proves: dense body links and open typed metadata relations compose in the same relation field without forcing one hierarchy or project ontology
weaker explicit link evidence remains distinct from richer typed authored or later derived relation origins
multiple provenance anchors may co-reference one semantic relation without erasing their source evidence
higher integrative readings consume the existing relation field rather than reclassifying authored source semantics
ordinary correctness remains independent of optional Quaternal Logic refraction

worlds.name: heterogeneous-retained-source
proves: an eligible source retained in a provider/domain-local location such as notes/ participates without migration into a proprietary Wiki directory
external plain-Markdown or Obsidian-style edits advance source revision and rebuild relation state through the same owner contracts
stable source/Wiki identity remains distinguishable from file/path locator and human title/alias
same-source rebuild preserves relation/backlink truth without rewriting canonical source

cross_world_acceptance: desktop/workbench consumes AIKit authored outgoing/backlink/pending/provenance read state rather than reparsing source bytes
the same selected stable ref survives Canvas, Inspector, Knowledge, Changed/Affected and explicit Contemplate
Factory retains canonical Project/Run cognition and opaque relationEvidenceRefs without parsing Markdown/OKF or owning backlinks
public Projection may rewrite eligible links to stable public routes only through existing explicit public eligibility; local authored relation does not automatically become public relation
private-by-default and source-authority boundaries remain intact
O:I owns no Markdown/OKF parser, resolver or second relation/backlink index
Contemplate remains the explicit intentional Agent line
no physical/local-machine acceptance evidence is claimed by W8
global_invariants: source files remain canonical; SemanticWiki relation/search/backlink state is rebuildable derived state
explicit authored relation origin is distinct from source epistemic authority
body and metadata relation evidence remain separately provenance-bearing even when they co-reference one target
unresolved/ambiguous evidence survives without fabricated targets
source/change/index/presentation work invokes no Agent/model automatically
open relation vocabulary does not transfer project ontology ownership to AIKit or O:I
ordinary correctness has no Quaternal Logic dependency; optional QL depth remains attributable/removable

evidence.rebuild-law: fresh SemanticWiki reconstruction from the same retained source world reproduces resolved/backlink/pending authored state
